start.notEnabled: This recipe is not enabled for this deployment.
start.fromDeviceOrAlert: Start this recipe from a device or an alert.

recipe.identityOffboardingSummary: Confirm who is leaving, route their mail, and remove their access across Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace in a safe order with one approval. Hand work is tracked on the ticket.
recipe.serviceRecoverySummary: Investigate a stopped Windows service, restart it with approval, and verify that it stays up.
recipe.identityOnboardingSummary: Create a new person's Microsoft 365 account with one approval, then assign the licences and groups you choose with a second. Google Workspace accounts are created by hand from a checklist item. The temporary password is revealed once, by the approver.

recipeLibrary.refreshFailed: The recipe library could not be refreshed; what is shown may be out of date.

startRecipe.title: Offboard a person

person.label: Person leaving
person.useHint: Use a name or email instead

autoReply.label: Auto-reply message
autoReply.defaultWithInheritor: Thank you for your email. {{person}} is no longer with the company. Please contact {{inheritor}} for help.
autoReply.defaultNoInheritor: Thank you for your email. {{person}} is no longer with the company, and this mailbox is no longer monitored.

cutoff.label: Last day (cutoff)
cutoff.now: Empty means start now: approved steps run as soon as the plan is approved.
cutoff.scheduled: Approved steps wait until this time before they run.

keepMailbox.label: Keep the mailbox
keepMailbox.help: Breeze will leave the Microsoft 365 licence in place and add a manual step to convert the mailbox to shared. Removing the licence first would start the mailbox's 30-day deletion clock.

effects.label: What to do
effects.autoReplyHelp: Answers new mail with the message above.
effects.forwardingHelp: Forwards new mail to the inheritor.
effects.mailDelegateHelp: Lets the inheritor read the whole mailbox. Choose this deliberately.
effects.removeGroupsHelp: Removes the person from groups and distribution lists.
effects.removeLicensesHelp: Frees paid licences once mail is handled.
effects.revokeSessionsHelp: Ends the person's active sign-in sessions.
effects.wipeMobileHelp: Removes the work account from enrolled phones. The device itself is not erased.
effects.disableAccountHelp: Disables the account. This comes last, after mail is routed.

devices.label: Devices to collect or lock
devices.help: Optional. Breeze does not act on devices in this recipe: each device you select becomes a checklist item for a technician.
devices.limit: You can select up to {{max}} devices.

preview.stale: The form changed since the preview. Preview again before starting.
preview.failed: The preview could not be made.
preview.title: Preview
preview.personUnresolved: No single contact matches. Choose one below, or change the name.
preview.personNone: No contact matches this name or email.
preview.orderNote: Grouped by service, not in order. The exact order is fixed after a technician confirms the identity, and is shown for approval before anything runs.
preview.degradedTitle: Steps that will be done by hand
preview.manualTitle: Checklist items the task will add
preview.ticketNote: The task opens its own ticket for these checklist items.
preview.ticketSourceNote: Started from a ticket: the task opens its own checklist ticket and does not change this one.

startRecipe.failed: The offboarding could not be started.
startRecipe.duplicate: An offboarding is already running for this person.
startRecipe.replayed: This offboarding had already been started; opening it.

onboarding.title: Onboard a person
onboarding.personWillBeCreated: This person will be created as a contact when the task starts.
onboarding.upnAvailable: Available: no Microsoft 365 account holds this sign-in name.
onboarding.upnTaken: Taken: a Microsoft 365 account already holds this sign-in name.
onboarding.upnUnchecked: This sign-in name could not be checked. Breeze will not create an account on a name nobody verified.
onboarding.usageLocationHelp: The country where the licences will be used, for example GB or US. Required before Microsoft 365 assigns a licence.
onboarding.skusHelp: A licence with no free seat is kept: the task turns it into a checklist item.
onboarding.groupsHelp: Dynamic and admin-role groups are never added automatically: the task turns them into checklist items.
onboarding.invalidEntry: Enter a value in the format shown.
onboarding.noSeats: No free seat confirmed: becomes a checklist item
onboarding.needsTechnician: A technician will add this one by hand
onboarding.googleManual: Breeze cannot create Google accounts yet. The task will add a checklist item with the exact details for you to create it by hand, then carry on with the licences and groups.
onboarding.orgUnitPathHelp: Starts with a slash, for example /Staff/Sales.
onboarding.modelAfterHelp: The task reads this person's groups and licences and asks you to confirm them at its first step. Admin and dynamic groups are never copied: the task adds those as checklist items.
onboarding.managerHelp: Recorded on the new contact and named in the handover. Breeze never changes the manager's accounts.
onboarding.managerPrefilled: Pre-filled from the ticket: its requester is set as the manager, not as the new person.
onboarding.startNow: Leave empty to provision and hand over now
onboarding.startScheduled: Accounts are created now; the handover waits until this time.
onboarding.startBeyondDeadline_one: This task must finish within {{count}} day. Pick a start date within {{count}} day, or start the onboarding nearer to it.
onboarding.startBeyondDeadline_other: This task must finish within {{count}} days. Pick a start date within {{count}} days, or start the onboarding nearer to it.
onboarding.invalid: Some details are missing or not in the right format:
onboarding.previewStage1: Step 1 — account creation (you approve this first)
onboarding.previewStage2: Step 2 — licences, groups and organizational unit (you approve this after the account exists)
onboarding.previewProvisional: Provisional: Breeze confirms these once the account exists
onboarding.previewNote: The task opens its own ticket for the checklist items.
onboarding.failed: The onboarding could not be started.
onboarding.duplicate: An onboarding is already running for this person.
onboarding.replayed: This onboarding had already been started; opening it.
onboarding.upnManual: Microsoft 365 accounts are created by hand for this organization, so Breeze did not check or plan this one.
onboarding.startAtIncomplete: Enter a full start date and time, or clear the field.
onboarding.invalidNoProvider: Turn on at least one account to create.

steps.waitingApproval: Waiting for approval of the plan.
steps.waitingMaintenanceWindow: Waiting for the maintenance window before the next change runs.
steps.waitingExecution: Running: waiting for the current change to finish.
steps.waitingHumanWork: Waiting for a technician to tick the checklist item on the ticket.

stepKey.manualCreateGoogle: Create the Google account by hand
stepKey.provisionEffects: Approve and assign licences and groups

plan.unavailable: This server did not send the plan for this task.
plan.empty: No plan has been proposed yet.
plan.supersededBy: Superseded by revision {{n}}. Kept here as the record of what was approved and then replaced.
plan.orderNote: Changes run one at a time in the numbered order, across services.
plan.noop: Already in place: nothing was sent.
plan.followedBy: Approved and carried out, then followed by approval {{n}} for the next stage. Kept here as the record of what was approved.

credential.askTo: Ask {{name}} to share the temporary password — only they can reveal it
credential.reveal: Reveal it in the AI activity feed (Approvals)
credential.expired: Temporary password expired without being revealed
credential.expiredRecovery: Reset the password. Do not create a second account.
credential.unretrievable: The temporary password was never stored, so nobody can reveal it.
credential.setByHand: Password set by hand during onboarding
credential.theApprover: the person who approved the account creation
credential.whoReveals: Only the person who approved the account creation can reveal a temporary password, once — not the technician who started this task. Hand it over in person or by phone.
credential.noRevealer: Breeze found nobody who can reveal this temporary password.
credential.revealNeedsFeedAccess: Only you can reveal it, in the AI activity feed (Approvals), but your role cannot open that page. Ask an administrator for AI session audit access.
